ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of low-intensity dark pixels across approximately 85-90% of the fluke surface, with high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered specular highlights from water spray.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Highly concentrated, contiguous white geometric blobs located at the extreme left and right distal tips; minimal white mottling present in the central medial regions of the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees; the vertex is clearly defined despite adjacent water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-frequency serrations with variable pixel amplitudes (ranging from 5-15 pixels in depth) extending across the entire visible trailing edge, becoming more pronounced and jagged toward the distal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Main body of lobes exhibits a moderate convex curve, transitioning into a sharp upward concave sweep as it reaches the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, roughly circular clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized on the outer margins and tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular scarring and calcified accretions on the trailing and outer edges of the distal tips, resulting in a highly disrupted and asymmetric boundary profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of deep, irregular trailing-edge notches near the right distal tip that deviate significantly from the primary serration frequency.
